title: A pin on the bar turns a transient pane into an anchor
body: Later. The Ctrl bar gets a pin toggle. Pinning a transient pane makes it an anchor whose rule is its current client's app id; unpinning makes an anchor transient again.
close_reason: ebf3115 adds a pin button to the Ctrl bar that turns a transient pane into an anchor and back. It works for apps with their own app id, such as nautilus. A pinned ghostty pane waits forever, which decade-7c65be covers.
